prompt: The team's product search index is an Elasticsearch-style read model — a derived, event-sourced projection of the write model that the team periodically rebuilds from scratch by replaying that history. The rebuild routine below is what's actually running in production: a full rebuild takes hours, and worse, while it runs, live product searches against that same index spike in latency and intermittently return half-populated results. Read the code, diagnose why it's both slow and disruptive to live traffic, and redesign the rebuild so a full replay is fast and completely invisible to users querying the index.
